messages:
Alex Chang: hey folks — want to sync quickly on prioritization for the new API spec bundle (chat/completions + embeddings + rerank). got a few incoming customer asks that may shift scope.
Maya Gupta: noted. which customer asks? short list pls.
Alex Chang: 1) enterprise customer wants deterministic rerank fallback when model times out; 2) small startup asks for combined embeddings + rerank single call to reduce tail latency; 3) infra team wants clearer batching semantics so Dedicated autoscaler can make better placement decisions.
Sanjay Patel: re: deterministic fallback — do we mean a cached top-k fallback or a simpler heuristic? need to call out acceptance criteria.
Alex Chang: cached top-k is preferred by the customer, but fallback heuristic acceptable for MVP. acceptance criteria proposal: 
- when primary rerank fails (timeout or OOM), return cached top-5 with metadata indicating fallback_used=true
- latency for fallback path must be < 200ms P95
- fallback must preserve original request ordering and score fields
Maya Gupta: sounds reasonable. what's the risk to unit economics? caching top-k across tenants raises memcost.
Devon Li: storing per-customer cached rankings is fine if we limit to recent N queries. propose config: cache_size_per_tenant=500 entries by default. also add TTL 24h.
Priya Rao: for the combined embeddings+rerank single call — is this an API surface change or just a convenience wrapper? need to be explicit in PRD.
Alex Chang: thinking wrapper endpoint POST /v1/rerank_with_embeddings that returns embeddings + rerank result, or accept precomputed embeddings to skip the embedding step. acceptance criteria: 
- endpoint supports both modes: compute_embeddings=true|false
- if compute_embeddings=false, validate embeddings shape and return 400 on mismatch
- docs include cost model example and token/compute breakdown
Maya Gupta: request we add an opt-in cost-metering header so we can show customers estimated unit cost in Console during beta.
Sanjay Patel: edge cases to call out in RFC: 
- inconsistent tokenization between embedder and reranker model
- embeddings with NaNs after quantization
- partial failures when embeddings succeed but rerank fails (need atomic semantics)
Alex Chang: propose atomic semantics: if rerank fails after embeddings computed, we still return embeddings (with rerank=null and error_code) and flag step_status. customers asked for embeddings even if rerank fails.
Devon Li: ok but that means double billing flows. product-bot: BillingPolicyCheck: ensure backend billing team signs off on partial-charge UX.
Priya Rao: launch criteria idea (must-have for GA): 
- API contract finalized and signed off by infra and sales
- acceptance tests: end-to-end smoke with 3 datasets, deterministic fallback passing
- perf targets: P95 generation latency < 300ms for small prompt, embeddings P95 < 120ms, rerank P95 < 200ms
- docs + SDK examples in three languages
Maya Gupta: also require an Eval harness to detect rerank regressions vs baseline on a 1k-case prompt set.
Alex Chang: tradeoffs: we can ship MVP with heuristic fallback (cheaper) and disabled combined endpoint; then iterate. or ship combined endpoint behind beta flag which adds surface area for support. thoughts?
Sanjay Patel: prefer beta flag for combined endpoint. heuristic fallback OK for initial GA as long as deterministic cache plan is in the roadmap with timeline.
Priya Rao: timeline ask from sales — they want GA in 8 weeks for 1 pilot. feasible?
Devon Li: 8 weeks tight but doable if we scope to heuristic fallback, beta combined endpoint behind flag, and limited caching. need dedicated infra sprint and an on-call post-launch for 2 weeks.
Maya Gupta: next steps: Alex to draft short PRD + RFC that includes acceptance criteria, edge cases list, perf targets, and rollout plan. include links: customer asks doc + sample contract clause.
Alex Chang: will do. I'll drop a PRD link shortly. can ppl review by EOD Friday? ping me with LGTMs or major blockers.
product-bot: Reminder: RFC template updated — please use /templates/rfc-v2 and tag @eng-platform for infra review.
Priya Rao: LGTM to the direction. minor ask: add a migration note for existing customers who call separate endpoints today.
Alex Chang: good call. adding migration note. thanks everyone :thumbsup:
